observed_sequence.fact: Windows diagnosed low virtual memory; system commit charge 33959481344 of limit 34227404800 bytes (267923456 bytes headroom).

observed_sequence.source: Docker Desktop host backend log, UTC 2026-10-06T18:50:28
observed_sequence.fact: WSL vpnkit-bridge exited with 0xc00000fd; backend recorded multiplexer disconnect and linux/wsl engine shutdown request.
A Docker exec API request returned HTTP 500; the AGENT_END capture hook then raised AttributeError on a missing stdout, masking the prior Docker failure.

causal_assessment: The memory-exhaustion event six seconds before the Docker/WSL disconnect is strong host-infrastructure evidence, but the OS/Docker logs do not prove which individual process caused the engine exit. The Harbor AttributeError is secondary cleanup failure, not the initiating error.
